reviews.title: vital info
reviews.comment: LG IPS dual mode monitor. I am coming from an Asus 240hz 1440p OLED to this because I was curious on the dual mode. I am surprised to say that if you cannot afford OLED then this is a very solid option, but i would suggest saving up more money to buy OLED. IPS is good if you don't want to worry about screen burn in. The colors on the ips are very good, But in comparision to the OLED there's a major difference. The OLED just litterally pops. The motion blur on the ips is very little, but like I said OLED>IPS. The stand is very solid on this LG monitor. I appreciate that. the connectivity on the back is very easy unlike my Asus Monitor which is underneath and hard to access.
reviews.author: ToddV

reviews.title: 4k120hz Monitor
reviews.comment: Fantastic monitor. Great response time, high quality, and more frames than you could ever use. As someone who’s been gaming for most of their life, this was a definite upgrade. You’re able to play 4K quality and 120hz no issue or FHD quality at well over 250hz+. Whether you’re on PC or console, this is a greats value for its price and changes everything for your set up.
reviews.author: Chris

reviews.title: Good buy
reviews.comment: I’ve been using the LG 27G810A-B for a bit now, and it’s one of the most impressive monitors I’ve owned—especially if you want both high resolution and high refresh rate in one screen.
